Graph viewer — the tag layer as a graph

Pick a view. Papers (coloured by discipline) link to statistical tags and to canonical phenomena. Drag nodes; click a paper to open it, or a tag to read what the corpus means by it. Tag names are shown where they fit — hover a dot for the rest. statistics report → · search →
